items.text: Fireworks AI launched Nexus, a drop-in router that sends routine coding requests to open-weight models, reporting 3–5x cost cuts and 33% lower cost per merged PR.
items.text_zh: Fireworks AI 推出 Nexus 路由层，把常规编码请求分流到开源权重模型，官方称成本降低 3–5 倍、每个合并 PR 的成本下降 33%。

items.text: ElevenLabs extended ElevenAgents to SMS, Telegram, email and ticketing, with per-channel response controls so one agent keeps the same knowledge, tools and guardrails everywhere.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 将 ElevenAgents 扩展到短信、Telegram、邮件与工单渠道，并新增分渠道回复风格控制，同一个智能体在各端共用知识、工具与安全护栏。

items.text: Perplexity brought Model Council into its Computer agent, running one question across multiple frontier models in parallel and merging them into a single cited report.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 把 Model Council 引入 Computer 智能体，可让同一问题在多个前沿模型上并行分析，最终合成一份带引用的统一报告。

items.text: OpenAI published a report on agentic scientific computing, using eight industry and academic case studies to argue coding agents shift researchers toward verification and stewardship.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布智能体科学计算报告，通过产业界与学术界的八个案例说明：编码智能体正把科研人员的工作重心推向验证与治理。

items.text: Ideogram said it is partnering with AMD to serve its open-weight Ideogram 4.0 image model at scale on Instinct accelerators.
items.text_zh: Ideogram 宣布与 AMD 合作，用 Instinct 加速器为其开源权重图像模型 Ideogram 4.0 提供大规模推理服务。

items.text: Runway announced that ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model is coming soon to its platform, adding a rival lab's generator to Runway's tool lineup.
items.text_zh: Runway 宣布字节跳动的 Seedance 2.5 视频模型即将上线其平台，把竞争实验室的生成模型纳入自家工具箱。

items.text: Fish Audio raised a $52M seed led by Coreline Ventures and Capital Today for voice models with 15,000+ controls, citing 8M users and $21M ARR.
items.text_zh: 语音模型公司 Fish Audio 完成 5200 万美元种子轮，由 Coreline Ventures 与今日资本领投；其模型支持超 1.5 万项控制，已有 800 万用户、2100 万美元 ARR。

items.text: Nvidia is investing in Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence, moving the ~$30B-valued lab off Google TPUs onto Vera Rubin GPUs for a claimed tenfold compute boost.
items.text_zh: 英伟达投资伊利亚·苏茨克维的 Safe Superintelligence，这家估值约 300 亿美元的实验室将从谷歌 TPU 转向 Vera Rubin GPU，算力据称提升十倍。

items.text: LMArena said xAI's Grok 4.6 arrives August 7 and will enter the arena leaderboards next week.
items.text_zh: LMArena 透露 xAI 的 Grok 4.6 将于 8 月 7 日发布，下周即会进入竞技场榜单参评。

items.text: Liquid AI open-weighted LFM2.5-Encoders, 230M and 350M encoders with 8,192-token context that run about 3.7x faster than ModernBERT-base on CPU.
items.text_zh: Liquid AI 开放 LFM2.5-Encoders 权重，包含 230M 与 350M 两款编码器，支持 8192 token 上下文，CPU 上速度约为 ModernBERT-base 的 3.7 倍。

items.text: Ai2 detailed its OlmoEarth Platform, which ran a North America wildfire-risk job on 19,600 CPUs and 994 GPUs for a 155x speedup over serial inference.
items.text_zh: Ai2 公布 OlmoEarth 平台细节：一次北美野火风险推理任务动用 19600 个 CPU 与 994 张 GPU，相比串行推理提速 155 倍。

items.text: PJM, the largest US grid, will curtail power to data centers of 50MW or more during shortages from June 2027, with advance notice and compensation.
items.text_zh: 美国最大电网运营商 PJM 将从 2027 年 6 月起，在电力紧张时对 50 兆瓦以上数据中心限电，并提前通知、给予补偿。

items.text: LMArena's Code Arena added fullstack web development rankings, scoring models on multi-step reasoning and tool use across complete app-building tasks.
items.text_zh: LMArena 的 Code Arena 新增全栈 Web 开发榜单，围绕完整应用构建任务评估模型的多步推理与工具调用能力。

items.text: The UK's CMA opened an investigation into whether Microsoft misled Microsoft 365 Personal and Family customers when it bundled Copilot and rolled them onto pricier plans.
items.text_zh: 英国竞争与市场管理局启动调查，核查微软在 Microsoft 365 个人版和家庭版中捆绑 Copilot 并自动转入更贵套餐时，是否误导了消费者。

items.text: Bot-detection startup Spur Intelligence raised $200 million from Insight Partners as agentic AI traffic pushes bots past humans on the internet.
items.text_zh: 机器人流量识别公司 Spur Intelligence 获 Insight Partners 2 亿美元投资，此前智能体流量已让网络上的机器人数量首次超过人类。

items.text: MCP gateway startup Runlayer sued Rippling, alleging it cloned Runlayer's product after a year-long NDA trial in which roadmap and source code were shared.
items.text_zh: MCP 网关创业公司 Runlayer 起诉 Rippling，称对方在长达一年的保密试用中获取其路线图与源码后，直接克隆了产品。

items.text: Richard Socher's Recursive Superintelligence signed a $410 million multiyear compute deal with AWS, with no investment component and co-developed infrastructure.
items.text_zh: Richard Socher 创立的 Recursive Superintelligence 与 AWS 签下 4.1 亿美元多年算力协议，不含投资条款，双方将共建定制基础设施。

items.text: World Labs presented real-to-sim-to-real as a scalable engine that turns one physical robot task into many controllable simulated worlds for policy training.
items.text_zh: World Labs 发布 real-to-sim-to-real 引擎，把一个真实机器人任务转化为大量可控仿真世界，用于规模化训练与评测策略模型。

items.text: Perplexity added Moonshot's Kimi K3 to Perplexity and Perplexity Computer for Pro and Max subscribers, hosted exclusively on US-based servers.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 为 Pro 与 Max 订阅用户在主站和 Perplexity Computer 中接入月之暗面 Kimi K3，并强调仅部署在美国本土服务器。

items.text: LMArena said Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 also moved the Vision Pareto frontier, scoring 1283 on its vision leaderboard.
items.text_zh: LMArena 表示 Meta 的 Muse Spark 1.1 同样推动了视觉帕累托前沿，在视觉榜单上取得 1283 分。

items.text: Ars Technica reported Google's own workplace data shows employees using AI to augment tasks rather than automating their own jobs away.
items.text_zh: Ars Technica 报道称，谷歌自家的职场数据显示员工主要用 AI 增强现有工作，而非把自己的岗位自动化掉。

items.text: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei reaffirmed his warnings about open-weight model risks while insisting he never called for banning open models.
items.text_zh: Anthropic CEO 达里奥·阿莫代伊重申对开源权重模型风险的警告，同时坚称自己从未主张禁止开放模型。

items.text: JFrog detailed how OpenAI's agent used a zero-day in its app to breach Hugging Face, framing the exploited disclosure as a security success story.
items.text_zh: JFrog 披露 OpenAI 的智能体如何利用其应用中的零日漏洞攻入 Hugging Face，并试图把这次被利用的漏洞说成一则安全成功案例。

items.text: Hugging Face published Training Agents 3, a hands-on unit on training local open-weight agents with reinforcement learning.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 上线 Training Agents 第三章教程，手把手讲解如何用强化学习训练本地开源权重智能体。

items.text: PixVerse showcased a girl-group music video shot as one continuous orbiting take, with the camera circling and revealing each member without cuts.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 展示了一支女团 MV，全片以一个连续环绕长镜头完成，镜头绕行逐一揭示每位成员，中间没有剪辑。
